newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Lower feeds prices in Europe spark trade in aftern.
newsitem.headline: Lower feeds prices in Europe spark trade in aftern.

text.p: Lower seller prices on the European meals and feeds market boosted some activity this afternoon, market sources said.
"With the current downtrend in the market today's business was a combination of sellers taking profit and buyers attracted by the lower levels despite the high dollar," one broker said.
Spot Argentine soymeal pellets traded at $288 a tonne fob Rotterdam.
Argentine sunmeal pellets traded around $5 under initial seller prices and included June at $129, July/Sept at $130 and Oct/Dec at $135 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
